productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Ignite young imaginations with thrilling tales of brave heroes, legendary beasts, and ancient magic from every corner of the world! Travel around the globe from the comfort of home with Myths of the World.  This captivating audio collection brings together legendary folklore from six incredible cultures: China, Greece, the Norse lands, Egypt, the Celtic Isles, and Japan. Listeners will meet brave heroes, fearsome monsters, clever tricksters, and powerful gods, all while discovering the rich heritage and storytelling traditions of ancient civilisations.  Whether listening during quiet play, long journeys, or winding down before bed, these thrilling tales are sure to ignite young imaginations and foster a lifelong love for global history and mythology. Tracks included: Opening credits Introduction Ancient Greece The Beginning The Fall of Ouranos The Birth of Zeus The War of the Titans The Olympian Gods The Sun the Moon and the Dawn Zeus King of the Gods Apollo and Artemis The Birth of Athena The Birth of Dionysus Hermes and the Lion Haphaestus's Revenge Demeter God of the Harvest The Kidnap of Persephone Hades God of the Underworld Orion  Humans and the Gods Pandora's Jar The Flood Dionysis and the Pirates Orpheus and Eurydice Hestia Goddess of the Hearth Midas Golden Touch Eros and Psyche Arachne Ares God of War The Trojan War Heroes Perseus and Medusa The Amazons Bellerothon and Pegasus Apollo Jason and the Argonauts Theseus and the Minotaur Aphrodite Goddes of Love and Beauty The Twelve Labours of Heracles Odysseus Voyage The Adventures of Atalanta About the Myths Greek Vases Mythical Beings Monsters of Myth Named for the Myths Worshipping the Gods Mount Olympus The Underworld Outro
